The '''Talecalle volcano chain''' was a series of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] located on the<ref name="Files" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Tujiamoor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tujiamoor system/Legends|Tujiamoor system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Tujiamoor]].<ref name="Files" />

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Talecalle volcano chain was created for the article "[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in the [[August]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]].<ref name="Files" />
